purpose: Make future cross-circumference support receipt assembly deterministic, duplicate-safe, and provenance-complete before scaling formal conversions.
required_provenance_assertions: PRE capture or original frozen witness predates the applicable PIT cutoff
official registration identity is exact and deterministic
prospective support-side row has contemporaneous official same-race assignment before cutoff
source artifact and source hash are bound
RESULT/payout/odds/forecast were not used in the support decision
duplicate_guards: A canonical row key already present in any confirmed support receipt MUST NOT increment supported rows again.
The same official registration number may appear in multiple valid rows, but confirmed_unique_riders increments only on first confirmed cross-circumference qualification.
A rider needs at least one valid 333/333.33 row and at least one valid 400 row to qualify as cross-circumference supported.
Multiple receipts for the same rider are merge/update evidence only unless they add a previously unseen canonical row key; they MUST NOT increment unique rider count twice.
Ambiguous or missing registration number, row hash, event binding, or cutoff provenance fails closed.
